## Three-dashboard and operational parity

- [ ] Talent impact is implemented or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] Employer impact is implemented or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] AdorWorks Operations can verify, moderate, support, recover, and measure the capability where required.
- [ ] Existing routes, data, and completed workflows remain compatible.

## Security and data

- [ ] Server-side role, tenant, and object authorization is tested.
- [ ] Data visibility and sensitive-field handling are documented.
- [ ] Migrations are additive, reversible, ordered, and reflected in generated types, or no migration is required.
- [ ] Sensitive actions have actor, timestamp, reason, and audit requirements.
- [ ] Material functionality is default-off behind a documented server flag.

## Product quality

- [ ] Empty, loading, success, error, offline/expired, and permission-denied states are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Critical flows are keyboard and screen-reader usable.
- [ ] Mobile, low-data, and desktop behaviour was checked.
- [ ] Unit, integration, E2E, lint, and build results are reported, including anything not run.
- [ ] Performance, security, privacy, trust, analytics, and content impacts are reported.
